يقترئ (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِئُ (yaqtariʔu) /jaq.ta.ri.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# يَقْتَرِئَ (yaqtariʔa) /jaq.ta.ri.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# يَقْتَرِئْ (yaqtariʔ) /jaq.ta.riʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
